Are you passionate about building software that powers real-world manufacturing and drives the digital transformation of global production? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.

As our new Full-Stack Software Developer, you'll be designing, developing, and maintaining full-stack applications for Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) that support critical production processes across Grundfos's global manufacturing sites. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Manufacturing IT team, you'll create impact by building scalable, integrated software solutions that connect enterprise systems with shop-floor operations, enabling smarter and more efficient production worldwide.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Design, develop, and deploy full-stack applications using .NET, C#, React, and MS SQL on local servers or Azure Cloud services

• Build APIs and backend services for system integration, including SAP and shop-floor automation equipment using industrial protocols such as OPC UA

• Collaborate with production engineering, IT, and infrastructure stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions

• Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts for build, test, and deployment workflows

• Ensure code quality through peer reviews, unit/integration testing, and adherence to coding standards within an agile SCRUM team

• Provide mentorship and technical guidance to associate developers while contributing to architectural discussions and continuous improvement

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a skilled full-stack developer with strong .NET and React experience, a solid grasp of system integration patterns, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical peers and domain experts in a fast-paced agile environment.

We'd also imagine that you are/have:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

• 3+ years of full-stack development experience with .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and MS SQL

• Solid understanding of software engineering principles and patterns (e.g., SOLID), RESTful APIs, and web application frameworks

• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting (e.g., PowerShell)

It's a plus if you also:

• Experience with Siemens Opcenter Discrete MES platform development and configuration

• Familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and/or shop-floor integration using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT)

• Experience with Azure Cloud services and containerized deployments

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

About Grundfos

Grundfos is one of the world’s leading water technology companies with more than 19.000 employees in 60+ countries all over the world. Our skills commit us to pioneering solutions to the world’s water and climate challenges and improve the quality of life for people. We dare to do things that others cannot or dare not do, as we believe innovation is not only a business opportunity, but an obligation. And what really matters to us is not short term profit, but the impact we make. By becoming part of our united powerful team, you too can drive this change no matter your role.

An inclusive team

We believe that the key to a work environment, where employees thrive and grow, is our ability to celebrate and value our differences in background, experiences and perspectives. In our recruitment process we welcome all professional people without consideration of age, colour, gender identity, national origin, physical or mental disability, ethnicity or religion.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Be open to feedback, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in your team.

**Your Skills

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learn the rest.

• Confident in software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

• Willingness to learn and work with in-house tools and frameworks, especially the APL programming language.

• Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or functional programming language (C# is a benefit).

• Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk-based development.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

**What Is It Like To Work Here

**SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**Benefits

**An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to the traditional benefits, we promote an effective work-life balance, including flexible work hours and a hybrid workplace model. As a large organization, we offer a wide range of career opportunities, with an individualized approach to professional development to support the career path you wish to pursue.

**NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Our purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

• Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• Some exposure to automated testing

• Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Kickstart your Career with Deloitte’s Finance Consultancy Programme
jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you interested in working in an exciting and challenging consulting role, where you can deploy and develop your skills and competencies within the CFO domain of companies? Do you hold a business-related Master’s degree by the summer of 2027, and are you ready to embark on a life-long learning journey in a leading global consulting firm? If yes, then we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Who we are

Joining our Finance Consultancy Programme, you will get to collaborate with experienced consultants on a wide variety of assignments and development opportunities. At Deloitte, we work with different project sizes across finance disciplines and industries, but the foundation is always the same: Our genuine passion for the CFO area and creating value together with our clients.

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte Technology & Transformation (former Consulting) consisting of more than 350 consultants in Denmark who work across all areas of the CFO function. We engage with clients to operate, advise, optimize, and transform their finance functions. Our clients range from domestic to international, from private to public, across various industries, sizes, and time horizons.

You will join a team that emphasizes collaboration, collegiality, coaching, and talent development. At Deloitte, we value diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, encouraging an inclusive and collaborative environment.

Job Description

Exciting tasks await you

As an Analyst in Deloitte Finance Transformation, you will experience that no workdays are the same. You will face a wide range of tasks, both in the form of interim-based roles and project-based assignments. Projects and tasks will vary across finance disciplines (e.g., operational finance or business finance) and industries (e.g., private or public), and within the first years of your career, you will be assigned to as many different projects and tasks as possible to expand your toolbox and build on your financial craftmanship.

Based on the specific client's needs and your interests, experiences, and competencies, typical assignments and projects could be within the scope of:

• Finance operations optimization and transformation, e.g., controlling, month-end closing, and reporting

• Transformation and digitalization of finance functions, e.g., process optimization, closing excellence, internal controls advisory, and leveraging technology solutions

• Enterprise performance management, e.g., analytics, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting

• ERP-enabled finance transformations and finance systems implementation, e.g., outlining the ERP-strategy, defining business requirements and ensuring consistent data migration

• Finance strategy and operating model, e.g., designing service delivery models, outlining roles and responsibilities and conducting assessments

• M&A readiness and finance post-merger integration

• Global business services transformations, e.g., assessing, developing and implementing shared service functions and aligning service delivery with corporate strategy

• Internal business development and leadership support, e.g., assisting on client proposals, facilitating events and developing material to strengthen our market offerings.

Onboarding and learning

When joining us, you will participate in our onboarding programme designed with the purpose of giving you the best foundation for kickstarting your career in Deloitte. During your first two weeks, you and your peers will attend our Finance Transformation Nordic Bootcamp and our Consultant Academy, where the content is tailored to match your competencies as recent graduates. The Finance Transformation Bootcamp helps you in building your finance craftmanship and toolbox, while the Consultant Academy prepares you for your consulting role in Deloitte Technology & Transformation. Also heavily focused on social activities and team-building, the onboarding programme provides a smooth transition from university as it offers a unique opportunity to connect and build strong relations with your fellow new joiners from day one.

At Deloitte, we believe in life-long learning, and we are committed to investing in your individual development, both professionally and personally, throughout your career. You will experience this with our Finance Consultancy Programme, which is a highly structured learning programme, aimed at equipping you with the appropriate skillset and the right level of competencies needed to succeed in your role.

Leadership and culture

To support your learning, you will also be assigned a People Leader as your closest leader and go-to sparring partner. Your People Leader will help you set the overall direction of your journey in Deloitte and provide guidance across projects to make sure that your individual aspirations and professional development goals are met. Every career path is unique, and together with your People Leader you get the chance to shape your own.

We believe in leadership at all levels, and we have committed ourselves to creating and maintaining an inclusive and psychologically safe culture, where you are encouraged and empowered to take responsibility while leading both yourself and others. We combine this with a substantial focus on continuously staying relevant and being a meaningful social community to our people. We are a people’s business, and therefore we strongly believe that this is an essential prerequisite for making an impact that truly matters – for ourselves and for our clients**.

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for you, who are passionate about consulting and the CFO-area and who are willing to go the extra mile to deliver sustainable impact that truly matters to our clients. You show an eagerness to make a difference for both clients and colleagues and you are able to see the opportunities and potential in all types of assignments. As our business can be highly changeable, it is important that you are curious by nature, and that you face challenges with an open-minded and solution-oriented approach.

In addition to this, you:

• Have completed a master’s degree within the fields of finance, economics, business, accounting, social sciences, IT, or similar areas in the summer of 2027 or before

• Have achieved academic results from your bachelor’s and master’s degree that you are proud of

• Demonstrate a flair for both oral and written communication and are fluent in English

• Have a legal working permit in Denmark

Although relevant job experience might be an advantage, this is not a requirement.

Additional Information

Want to know more?

Click the "I'm interested"-button above and upload your CV and grade transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degree if you are interested and ready to join our team**. Instead of an application letter, we would like you to answer the questions you will be presented with on the next pages** (please only consider the required (*) fields). As we process applications and arrange interviews on an ongoing basis, we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Application deadline: Hiring on an ongoing basis.

Please do not hesitate to contact Giulio Marano (gimarano@deloitte.dk / +45 30 93 64 11) or Maria Banke (mbanke@deloitte.dk / +45 20 97 64 15) if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Company Description

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for the next step in your career? At Deloitte Engineering, we are looking for recent graduates and early-career software developers who want to strengthen their technical and problem-solving capabilities while helping us grow our Engineering practice. You will have the opportunity to work hands-on with software development while applying your skills in a consulting environment, working with clients to solve complex business and technology challenges.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Technology & Transformation.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, architects, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software developer. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a software developer at the Engineering offering, you will work with many different aspects of development, from writing code to testing it. You will work closely with both clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet their business needs and technical requirements. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development.

• Assisting in the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and adopting DevOps practices to streamline development workflows.

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You hold a Master’s degree, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Development, or another relevant technical field. You are either a recent graduate or have up to 4 years of full-time professional experience, preferably within software development. Experience from student positions, internships, or part-time software development roles is also considered an advantage. You enjoy applying your analytical and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and are motivated by working both hands-on with software and in a client-facing consulting environment. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

• Experience in Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, or one or more other widely used programming languages.

• Some experience with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and test automation.

• Some experience with modern system design and software architecture principles.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

• You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.

• You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

• Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.

• Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.

• The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027.

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

Disclosure on the Use of AI: We want to ensure that all applicants receive fair treatment in our recruitment process. This role is part of a pilot where we are testing an innovative approach to recruitment using AI, and therefore you should not upload a traditional cover letter. We want to be completely transparent about the pilot – Read more here.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Turn insights into acquisition experiments that scale

**About Good Tape

**At Good Tape, we’re building tools that make working with voice and audio effortless. We help journalists, researchers, and organisations capture, transcribe, and analyse conversations at scale. Our team is small, ambitious, and deeply technical, and we care about reliability and craft.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own Good Tape's acquisition engine: performance marketing, SEO, creative and to fuel our sales motion with a steady flow of qualified demand. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with the broader commercial team: Sales, Data, Product Marketing and Customer Success. Your job is to make sure the right people see (and click on) us in the first place, and keep coming back.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product to market.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Own performance marketing across paid channels, from strategy to execution.

• Drive SEO and organic acquisition, including content and site structure.

• Develop creative strategy and messaging for campaigns and launches.

• Own lifecycle and CRM: nurture flows, retention, and reactivation.

• Own top-of-funnel website content and landing pages; the pages that bring people in.

• Fuel SLG by partnering closely with Sales on positioning, demand gen, and maximizing MQL-to-SQL conversion.

• Feed acquisition learnings into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• Design skills (e.g. static/video ad creative) are a great plus, not a hard requirement

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in data-driven marketing, growth experimentation, and core SaaS metrics.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our brand, acquisition funnels, and demand gen engine.

• Help define how Good Tape reaches the people who need it.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into pipeline and growth.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.

Description

Are you motivated by helping build structure, processes and culture in a small organization in the start-up phase? Do you have a clear picture of your preferred workplace and a strong experience, feeling and knowledge on how to create such a workplace? And are attracted by a strong purpose in an organization? Then you might be our new People & Operations Manager.

About us

About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Clinical Sciences, you'll help turn Hemab's science into well-designed clinical studies and clear evidence about how our treatments perform in patients. You'll take scientific ownership across protocol development, study execution and data interpretation, working closely with Medical Directors and colleagues across clinical development, regulatory and other functions.

What you'll do

• Lead the clinical science contribution to study strategy, design and execution, keeping the scientific questions and patient needs at the centre of decisions.

• Drive protocol development with the Medical Director, including amendments as emerging data or study needs require.

• Own the scientific review of clinical study data, identify discrepancies and trends, and turn emerging safety and efficacy data into clear questions and actions for the team.

• Shape study documents and plans, including informed consent forms, eCRFs, medical monitoring plans and data review plans.

• Guide sites and vendors on protocol requirements, eligibility criteria and participant management so studies are executed consistently and to the intended design.

• Partner across clinical development to analyse and interpret study results and build a clear understanding of what the data mean.

• Translate study findings for internal and external audiences alongside the Medical Director.

• Develop clinical content for regulatory documents, including investigator brochures, annual safety reports, clinical study reports and registration submissions.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Substantial clinical science or clinical research experience in drug development, with direct responsibility for clinical studies.

• Experience developing clinical protocols and interpreting safety and efficacy data from interventional studies.

• A strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical study design and drug development in a regulated environment.

• The scientific judgement to interpret clinical information, literature and changing treatment approaches and apply it to study and development decisions.

• Experience working effectively with investigators, vendors and cross-functional clinical, medical and regulatory colleagues.

Nice to have

• Experience in haematology, rare disease or bleeding disorders.

• Experience contributing to development programmes through later-stage studies and registration.

• An advanced scientific or clinical degree.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. Job description

We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• Design and implement planning excellence: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• Enable adoption and capability building: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• Translate requirements into actionable processes: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• Guide digital planning transformations: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• Deliver measurable impact: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note that for the first year, you’ll be employed in our Copenhagen office, Implement’s HQ, before joining the Zurich office.

What you’ll bring

As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• Relevant experience: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• Project-driven and adaptable: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• Interest in digital tools: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• Analytical problem-solver: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

jobs.description:
Coordinate complex prototype activities that enable better medical devices.

At Coloplast, we develop products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. In this role, you help our development projects turn product concepts into prototypes: for design iterations, usability studies, clinical trials, and design verification.

You bring structure to technically complex work. You connect engineers, manufacturing specialists and project teams around one plan. Your job is to build the integrated overview, maintain appropriate traceability and make the complete prototype flow work across the relevant stages of product development

Make complex prototype flows work

You coordinate prototype activities in complex development projects. That can mean multiple prototype variants, several manufacturing steps or sites, shifting levels of design maturity, demanding traceability requirements, or a wide stakeholder group.

This is an engineering-based coordination role: you will not be expected to manufacture the prototypes yourself or replace the technical specialists who define the prototype needs and requirements. The technical specialists remain responsible for defining their prototype needs, while the manufacturing teams remain responsible for production execution and manufacturing documentation. You bring these contributions together into one coherent and executable prototype plan. You build plans, spot dependencies and missing information, keep things visible, and push unresolved issues to a decision.

Join a growing engineering capability

You'll join our Test Development Engineering team: Test Development Engineers and Prototype Engineering Specialists, supporting product-development projects across Coloplast.

In this role you’ll have a broad footprint across the whole organization. You'll work closely with Product Development Project Managers, Test Engineers, Mechanical Design Engineers, Clinical and Usability colleagues, Quality Assurance, manufacturing sites, and external partners. You'll also work with the other Prototype Engineering Specialists to build consistent, practical ways of managing prototype activities across the team.

Your key responsibilities are:

• Coordinate complex prototype activities from early project planning through the final samples the project needs.

• Establish and maintain appropriate project-level prototype traceability, including references to the relevant manufacturing documentation.

• Build and maintain one overview of prototype purpose, quantities, variants, maturity, timing, manufacturing flow.

• Align prototype requesters with internal or external manufacturers.

• Challenge unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before they cause delays.

• Coordinate dependencies across components, prototype versions, manufacturing processes, sites, and project activities.

• Keep prototype status, decisions, risks, and open actions visible to everyone who needs them.

• Spot planning, capacity, documentation, and delivery risks early, and work with the right people to fix them.

• Help improve the processes, templates, and working methods for prototype management.

What you bring

Your engineering background lets you challenge weak assumptions, identify gaps, and bring in the right specialist at the right time. You need technical understanding to see how requirements, product variants, materials, manufacturing processes, documentation, and timelines affect each other.

Your real contribution is keeping the complexity manageable, so the team delivers.

We expect that you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, life science, pharmaceutics, or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience coordinating technical activities in product development, manufacturing, engineering, or a similar environment.

• Can turn input from several disciplines into a structured plan people can execute.

• Thrive in a central role, with multiple stakeholder interactions.

• Understand manufacturing flows and how product design, materials, processes, and documentation connect.

• Work confidently with requirements, dependencies, risks, traceability, and shifting priorities.

• Communicate clearly across functions and professional disciplines.

• Take a proactive, practical, accountable approach to commitments and deadlines.

• Are comfortable working in English in an international organization.

Experience in medical devices, life science, or another regulated environment is a plus. So is familiarity with prototype production, design verification, configuration management, quality systems, or coordination across multiple manufacturing sites.
